# REMAINING WORK — Geelooy Social Posting

## Current completion gate

Finish and verify durable Internet-facing media evidence through the canonical Awtsmoos post flow before beginning the mobile-first Social Hub redesign or external-network auto-posting.

## Known work

- [x] Inspect social/composer/hub/editor surfaces.
- [x] Trace composer → unified publish API → publication executor → rich post → native post.
- [x] Verify client success-garment unwrap.
- [x] Verify `seriesId` propagation.
- [x] Inspect Archive.org upload path, retries, receipt ledger, verification, and returned asset.
- [x] Identify concrete gap: Archive storage evidence and byte size are dropped by client/server attachment normalization.
- [x] Compare architectures and choose generic per-attachment storage provenance.
- [ ] Create client `AttachmentStorage.js`.
- [ ] Rewrite client `PostPayloadParts.js` in full to include optional storage and Archive bytes → size.
- [ ] Create server `AttachmentStorageSchema.js`.
- [ ] Rewrite server `AttachmentSchema.js` in full to preserve only bounded optional storage.
- [ ] Create focused client storage contract test.
- [ ] Create focused server storage contract test.
- [ ] Read back every touched source/test file in full.
- [ ] Run syntax checks.
- [ ] Run new client/server contract tests.
- [ ] Run existing rich-social schema/service tests.
- [ ] Run composer publication-truth tests.
- [ ] Execute an in-process representative Archive attachment round-trip through client payload and server normalization.
- [ ] Inspect live/runtime composer route after code tests.
- [ ] Write planned-vs-actual delta and resolve any discovered work.
- [ ] Prove this completion gate closed with evidence.

## Deferred user-requested next mission

Only after the gate above closes:

- [ ] Audit Social Hub on phone widths first.
- [ ] Make post creation the dominant easy mobile action.
- [ ] Remove loose labels/text by giving every visible element an intentional styled container/state.
- [ ] Make all components responsive, touch-friendly, keyboard-safe, and overflow-safe.
- [ ] Design account-linking for YouTube Community, Facebook, and Instagram.
- [ ] Verify current provider API/OAuth/publishing constraints from official sources before implementation.
- [ ] Plug external providers into the existing canonical-first secondary-placement architecture.
- [ ] Provide per-network result, retry, idempotency, and partial-failure UX.

## NEXT_ACTION

Create the two storage mapper/schema modules, then rewrite their two parent attachment modules in full.

The Awtsmoos renews the world in every instant; this ledger renews the mission in every pass. Awtsmoos.com should not call a path complete while public evidence falls through the cracks.
